questions.prompt: Which information can people find through the new website?
options: The cost of renting a home and buying a pump.
Local flood risks and ways to receive warnings.
The names of builders and prices of repairs.
New house prices and dates of building work.
questions.explanationZh: s3说明住宅附近的洪水风险与获取预警的方法；s4–5补充天气警报及房屋防护措施，并未提供房租、建造商名单或房价。

questions.prompt: Which two kinds of work does the announcement describe?
options: Advice for homeowners and practical flood protection.
Weather reports for travellers and new road building.
Training for computer users and repairs to schools.
Help with moving house and cheaper home insurance.
questions.explanationZh: 网站集中提供风险、预警和房屋防护信息；此外还有防洪设施建设维修、设备与应急人员。两者分别是信息支持和实际防洪工作。

questions.prompt: How does the Environment Agency organise its emergency response?
options: It keeps 600 people on call at any one time.
It sends 600 people to every flooded house.
It puts 260 people on call during the day.
It sends 25 people to answer each warning.
questions.explanationZh: s10明确任何一个时刻都有600人待命，且昼夜响应；260是水泵台数，25是临时屏障的公里数。
